suggestions.title: Automation suggestions
suggestions.subtitle: Suggestions grown from decisions you repeated; every one needs your confirmation, the system never changes itself.
suggestions.list.title: Suggestions awaiting your call
suggestions.list.empty: No suggestions right now: your decisions have not repeated enough to be worth asking about.
suggestions.cooldown.title: Suggestions in cooldown
suggestions.cooldown.note: After a dismissal the same (tool + param) stays quiet for 7 days; once it expires and the trend is still there, it comes back. The deadline is computed server-side, never in the page.
suggestions.feature.note: Turning it off stops generating and prompting: your decisions are still recorded, you just get no suggestions.
suggestions.feature.durable: The switch is service-level and in-memory: a restart returns it to the default (on); this build does not persist it.
suggestions.feature.denied: This account has no settings.write: the switch is service-level, so read-only roles cannot turn suggestions off for everyone.
suggestions.action.denied: This account has no intervene.decide: the buttons are disabled, suggestions are read-only here.
suggestions.poll.note: Quiet by design: queried on demand when this panel opens or a tab is switched, throttled to once per 60 seconds, never blocking the UI.
suggestions.poll.timing: There is no push channel: this uses query moments (panel open / tab switch + 60 s throttle), not server push; after a page refresh “Later” starts counting again.
suggestions.pref.title: Active preferences
suggestions.pref.empty: No preferences yet: accepted suggestions or manual entries show up here.
suggestions.pref.add.title: Add a preference manually
suggestions.pref.invalid: Tool and parameter names must not be empty, and the value has to be a JSON scalar.
suggestions.pref.unsupported: Deleting / clearing preferences: the backend does not provide that endpoint (T31 offers read plus same-key upsert only), so the UI offers no delete button.
suggestions.toast.accepted: Accepted: the preference is stored and will prefill matching decisions.
suggestions.toast.dismissed: Dismissed: this one stays quiet for {days} days.
suggestions.toast.new.many: {count} new suggestions: review them one by one in the Suggestions panel.
suggestions.toast.later.done: This suggestion stays quiet for the rest of the page session (prompting resumes after a refresh).
